title: How an Apple AirTag led to a Search Warrant
description:
Portions of this video were released previously but never really told the FULL STORY of how a modern Apple AirTag collided head-on with a 250-year-old constitutional amendment - which ultimately resulted in a judge getting involved. I personally love seeing cases like this where patrol officers go into full detective mode - going above and beyond to develop the probable cause to request a search warrant - and, in this case, it was quickly signed off by a judge. Sometimes, the quiet, time-consuming and diligent work of law enforcement deserves a dedicated story like this!
